data: With a roar, flames burst from your body in a {shape}, centered on you. Any creature in range must roll a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The power of the move exhausts you, and your next attack is done at disadvantage. If your next attack requires a creature saving throw, they have advantage.
A very appealing move, but after using this move, the user is more easily startled.
Pokemon has disadvantage on all CHA Saving Throws for the remainder of the Appeal Rounds.
